build_system: cTrader Automate (cAlgo). Built/compiled INSIDE the cTrader desktop app against its bundled cAlgo.API assemblies. No dotnet/nuget/msbuild project files in repo.
test_framework: None. No unit tests exist. Verification is manual: user compiles and runs inside cTrader Automate.
build_command: N/A in sandbox. cAlgo.API assemblies are NOT available here; `dotnet build`/`nuget restore` against cAlgo WILL fail. Build happens inside cTrader Automate on the user's machine.
test_command: N/A. No automated tests. User verifies by compiling + backtesting in cTrader.
verification_instructions: Static verification only in sandbox: (1) careful C#/cAlgo API self-review of SmcFvgBot.cs; (2) confirm the file still parses as valid C# by reasoning (no compiler available); (3) confirm additive behavior: with SL Mode=Pips and TP Mode=Pips/RRR the code path is byte-for-byte behaviorally identical to before. Real compile/run happens in cTrader Automate by the user.
setup_instructions: None required in sandbox. To edit: work on branch feat/ctrader-dollar-sltp, edit SmcFvgBot.cs at repo root only.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY-style: cAlgo.API assemblies unavailable; C# cannot be compiled or run in this sandbox. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator handles publish/merge). Deliverable = committed work on branch feat/ctrader-dollar-sltp.
contribution_requirements: Edit ONLY SmcFvgBot.cs at repo root. Do NOT modify any .pine files. Keep cAlgo idioms and existing code conventions/comment style.
key_patterns: Bot is a Robot subclass. Parameters via [Parameter(...)] attributes grouped by Group="Risk"/"Entry"/"Structure"/"Dashboard". Enums declared at namespace scope and used as [Parameter] types (FvgSource, EntryMode, EntryFib, TpMode). Own orders/positions/history filtered by label prefix BotLabelPrefix = "SmcFvg_". Orders placed in PlaceStrategyOrder via ExecuteMarketOrder(TradeType, SymbolName, volume, label, slPips, tpPips) or PlaceLimitOrder(TradeType, SymbolName, volume, targetPrice, label, slPips, tpPips) with nullable double? SL/TP pips (<=0 mapped to null). Lifecycle: OnStart inits state, OnBar runs detection+entry on Last(1), OnStop removes dashboard. Currently NO OnTick.
relevant_files: SmcFvgBot.cs (the ONLY file to edit; ~733 lines) - see enum TpMode (currently {Points, RRR}), PlaceStrategyOrder (SL/TP pip computation ~lines 590-640), OnStart/OnBar/OnStop lifecycle, [Parameter] Risk group, BotLabelPrefix filtering.
directory_structure: Repo root: SmcFvgBot.cs (target), README.md, several *.pine scripts (out of scope). .agents/tasks holds prior task plans.
